trigger: Night. The Air Guard ramp at Reno-Tahoe. The -86 ground power cart.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Late October. The ramp is dark. Three C-130s under a cold moon, like sleeping cattle.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The power carts sit by Hangar 2. Yellow, 90 kilowatts, tow bar up. A sentry stamps his feet by a burn barrel.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You belly across the ramp. Wraith flattens beside you, perfect as a training video. The sentry never turns.

nodes.speaker: authority_guard
nodes.text: Who's there? ...Wait. Are you motor pool? You look like motor pool.

choices.text: Captain wants a cart at Steamboat.
I was a crew chief. Just looking.

nodes.speaker: authority_guard
nodes.text: Nobody tells me anything. Sign here. Bring it back with gas in it.

nodes.speaker: authority_guard
nodes.text: Crew chief? I'm a Guard cook. They gave me a rifle and a barrel. ...Take it. I didn't see.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The tug coughs, catches. A flashlight swings. Somebody yells. You're already moving.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Tow bar on the pintle. Fuel gauge: three-quarters. Eight miles of dark road to Steamboat.
